capabilities: Open Google placeholder files in embedded views and wikilink embeds
Link placeholders to Google URLs automatically via the Windows Shell copy-link action
Accept manually pasted Google URLs when automatic linking fails
Manage a local registry of path-to-URL mappings with import, export, update, copy, removal, and rename migration
Apply an adjustable dark filter to embedded Google pages
disambiguation: Not a general link manager; it only opens Google Drive placeholder files in embedded views.
extras: Automatic linking temporarily overwrites the Windows clipboard. macOS and Linux are not supported and the author asks for a macOS contributor. Dark mode is labelled experimental and may leave visual artefacts in Google-hosted iframes. No telemetry, paid features, or use of the Google Drive API.
intentEvidence: GLink is a standalone plugin because it solves a different Google Drive storage case.
motivation: The author built it because, with Google Drive's streamed-file mode on Windows, placeholders cannot be opened or downloaded for parsing, so the shortcut-JSON approach of the existing GDocs plugin does not work.
problem: Obsidian cannot open Google Drive streamed-file cloud placeholders, which standard file reads cannot parse and which lack the shortcut JSON other tools rely on.

relations.evidence: The file-view, embedded-webview, and extension-registration approach is derived from oilandrust/obsidian-gdocs, used under the MIT License.
It is developed and tested with Google Drive for desktop on Windows 11.

summary: Opens Google Drive placeholder files (.gdoc, .gsheet, .gslides) in embedded Obsidian views on Windows using a local path-to-URL registry.
